maya: Quick RFC follow-up: I built a small staging gateway to route by precision profile (fp8/int8/4bit). Purpose: shadow/canary per-tenant without touching prod. Thoughts on safety checks?

sam: How will it verify compatibility? read artifact metadata + profile signature or let runtime reject?

liam: Perf context: fp8~1.6x vs int8; 4-bit ~2.7x on our infra. Calibration can add rollout latency. Need to avoid batch shifts during canary for 99p SLOs.

jess: Ops: +1. Route types: shadow|canary|active. Use X-Precision-Profile header. Canaries get qps cap + auto-rollback on "degradation" alarm. I'll own runbook.

maya: Gateway should: validate profile signature (metadata key: precision.profile.v1), enforce per-tenant allowlist, add provenance headers (X-Profile-Source, X-Profile-Version), fallback backend float32.

sam: Standardize metadata keys and enum for formats. Include checksum of quant table; mismatch -> 409 or reroute to fallback with reason header.

liam: When switching precision lanes, emit KV-cache-invalidate hint so runtime can rekey/force cold start: header X-KV-Invalidate: true. Prevent cache poisoning.

arjun: Telemetry: per-token degscore, 1m latency hist, 5m rolling degscore, shadow sampling (2%). Auto-fail if quality delta exceeds threshold for N prompts. Capture prompt hashes for audit.

jess: Runbook checklist: enable shadow -> smoke prompts -> monitor degscore & latency -> escalate or auto-rollback. Will add checklist and link.

maya: Proposal: quality_escrow flag for large tenant cutovers; return 202 and queue until validation job completes.

sam: Default fallback float32. Add opt-in header X-Allow-Lowbit: true for customers who accept best-effort low-bit.

liam: Gateway must avoid batching requests across different quant lanes. Separate batch queues or guard tokens.

arjun: Add observability tags: profile_version, profile_source, fallback_reason, degscore_delta. Wire dashboards for SRE/SE filtering.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staged deploy started 1 staging-gateway v0.1 -> staging cluster. CI: unit+integration passed.

jess: Tagging @maya @liam for smoke. :rocket:
